records.notes: Visible forms differ in the final weak-letter/hamza form of نَبِيٍّ; no subtype asserted.
Visible forms preserve الْجَمْعَانِ; initial alif and standing-alif presentation differs.
Hafs and Shubah visibly use تَعْمَلُونَ while the other editions use يَعْمَلُونَ.
Visible forms preserve بِظَلَّامٍ; standing-alif presentation differs.
The editions visibly divide between لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ and لَيُبَيِّنُنَّهُ.
